text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, well! Mile Championship,<n>we meet at
last!
choice_data_list: Is your head in the game?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You bet it is! All that's left is to run<n>my heart out!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that reminds me. I oughta say<n>howdy to Suzuka
before the race<n>starts.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka's my pal... but today, she's<n>the rival I
wanna beat more than<n>anybody.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: We'll leave the jawin' for after the<n>race!
choice_data_list: Make it a race to remember!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Just ya wait! You and Suzuka are<n>gonna be blown
away by my<n>super-charged running!
